Heritage · Creation · Learning

Preserving what matters.
Creating what’s next.

We often inherit beautiful things without documenting them, experience things without pausing to understand them, and create things without thinking about what they might mean years from now.

Root and Canvas sits somewhere in between what we inherit and what we create.

A little more room for what matters.
Somewhere along the way

We forget the things that make life ours.

We get busy. We grow up. Life moves forward. And in the middle of it all, some of the things that once made us feel at home begin to slip away.

01

The recipes we thought we'd always remember.

The taste of something made by our mothers and grandmothers. The little kitchen secrets passed down without a written word. The stories behind the food we grew up eating.

02

The creativity we keep putting off.

The painting we want to make, the book we want to read, the thoughts we want to write down—all the little things we love, waiting for us to find time for them again.

03

The things we wish we understood better.

Our bodies, our everyday choices, the world around us and the small practices that help us live with greater awareness.

We don't need more things to do.We need more ways to reconnect with what already matters.
A thoughtful little universe

Rooted in what matters. Open to what’s possible.

Root and Canvas is a space for preserving the meaningful, exploring the creative and discovering the everyday. Through thoughtfully created products, resources and experiences, we bring together three everyday anchors of a fulfilling life.

ROOT

The comfort of belonging.

Recipes are more than instructions. They carry memories, family histories, places and people we never want to forget.

Explore food and story archival, personalised resources and meaningful experiences.

CANVAS

The freedom to create.

Not everything needs to be productive. Some things simply need to bring us joy.

From books and writing to painting, photography and reading, make room for the things you love.

AWARE

The joy of understanding.

A little knowledge can change how we experience an ordinary day.

Discover approachable resources for learning, reflection, gratitude, curiosity and more conscious habits.

Three anchors. One meaningful life.
What makes Root and Canvas different?

Not just things to own. Things to carry with you.

Because moving forward doesn't have to mean leaving everything behind.

01

Made for everyday life.

Ideas, products and resources that find a place in your everyday routines.

02

Inspired by where we come from.

Honouring the knowledge, memories and traditions that shape us, while making room for new possibilities.

03

Created to spark something within you.

Every offering begins with a meaningful purpose—a recipe worth saving, a page worth writing or an idea worth exploring.

04

A growing space, with room for everyone.

From preserving what we inherit to discovering what we love, you're welcome wherever you are in your journey.

A FRIENDLY HELLO FROM THE FOUNDER

Dear You,

I’ve always felt that some of the most meaningful parts of life are also the easiest to overlook. Root and Canvas grew from my desire to bring these everyday anchors a little closer to our lives.

It’s a space I’m building with a lot of heart, curiosity, and room to grow and I’m so happy you’re here!

May you always find a little piece of yourself in the things you preserve, the things you create, and the things you discover.

Until then, stay rooted in what matters and remain open to all that you can become.

With warmth and sunshine,
Muskan Priya

Preserving what matters and creating what’s next.
